name: zeffect_set_variant_override_packed_ids_if_complete
description: zEffect::SetVariantOverridePackedIdsIfComplete enables and stores a packed variant override only when the tag count is nonzero and every counted tag byte is complete.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x458b20 validates fastcall ECX=packedIds, early return when count is zero, counted tag scan returning when any tag byte is 0xff, g_zEffect_VariantOverrideEnabled set to 1 only for complete tags, and g_zEffect_VariantOverridePackedIds receiving the packed first dword of the tag struct.
The native smoke verifies the complete-tag update path and that zero-count or 0xff-within-count inputs leave both override globals unchanged.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x458b20 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect/source-cluster pass.
